distribution.narrative: Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) reports Pityophthorus micrographus from North China at species rank, without identifying a subspecies. The original regional attribution remains broad. The Chinese occurrence remains a candidate pending review.

host_note: Host information has not yet been reviewed for this checklist record.
taxonomy_summary: Chinese occurrence evidence is reported at species rank as Pityophthorus micrographus (Linnaeus, 1758). Johnson et al. (2026) recognizes two subspecies, but the Chinese catalogue record does not establish a subspecific identification.

taxonomic_history.name: Pityophthorus micrographus micrographus
taxonomic_history.note: One of two subspecies recognized by Johnson et al. (2026). The cited Chinese occurrence is identified only at species rank and is not assigned to either subspecies.

nomenclature_note: Johnson et al. (2026) recognizes Pityophthorus micrographus micrographus and Pityophthorus micrographus sibiricus as valid subspecies. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) reports the Chinese occurrence at species rank, without subspecific assignment; the nominotypical subspecies is not confirmed by this record.
